## TBS Launcher 1.2.3

**Fixed:** if a NeoForge install was ever interrupted (launcher closed, antivirus got in the way), the game crashed right on start. The launcher now detects a half-installed NeoForge and reinstalls it.

One-click launcher for **The Broken Script Enhanced** (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge) and the **HelpUs** server. Download `TBS-Launcher.exe` below and run it. If Windows SmartScreen warns you, click *More info → Run anyway*.
